title: Caldo verde with kale, white beans and chouriço
steps: Chop the onion and garlic and peel and dice the potatoes.
Sweat them in the oil for 3 minutes, add the stock, simmer for 15 minutes and blend until smooth.
Dice the chicken, slice the chouriço thinly and cut the kale into very fine strips.
Add the chicken, chouriço, beans and kale to the soup, simmer for 8 minutes and season with salt.
